question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

A couple of parrots ________ on the telephone wires.
solution:
The correct answer is **'perched'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is** 'perched'.**
